convert_sonar_speech_checkpoint: convert a sonar speech checkpoint state dict to fairseq2 format using regex key mapping
convert_fairseq_state_dict: convert a fairseq state dict by applying regex-based key remapping rules
map_encoder_keys: map w2v-bert encoder layer keys to sonar encoder layer keys using regex patterns
map_decoder_keys: map fairseq decoder layer keys to sonar encoder pooler decoder keys using regex patterns
handle_conformer_layer_norm: handle redundant conformer layer norm by remapping it to the sonar block when use_conformer is true
